_comment: CAPTURE lane for S10, seeded from run://S09-exit.json. §H names the Warden on the mandatory continuous-evidence list; under the split that becomes S10-SEQ-warden, a bounded sixty-frame sequence over the fight.
_comment_generated: GENERATED by tools/gate_f/derive_capture_lane.py from S10.json. Do not hand-edit: change the source segment or the authored notes in the generator and regenerate, or the capture lane stops being the journey's own path and §H.1's provenance claim stops being true. `--check` fails CI-style if the two have drifted.
_comment_derivation: Kept: every step of S10 up to and including its last capture (index 91 of 119), minus note/defect/probe_cell/save_out and the four pacing asserts. 84 of 120 steps survive. Step ids carry their origin in `_derived_from`.
_comment_seeding: Run this into the SAME run directory as the logic lanes. Its `seed_save` steps resolve `run://` against that directory's saves, so a capture lane run anywhere else has no chapter to load and will stop at its first seed.
_comment_cost: The most expensive capture lane in the protocol, and it is worth saying why rather than only that it is: EVERY ONE of its frames is class D. The Hall interior, the pre-fight dialogue, the fight, the legendary chamber, the release ceremony and the healed meadow are all behind the Warden, and the Warden is behind the gauntlet. There is no save between S09-exit and the end of the chapter, so S10C is the finale played through. Whatever host runs the capture lanes has to be able to afford that one entire.

GF-13-FINALE-01.why: the Hall interior gauntlet space -- inside the Outer Works, which S09-exit is not.

GF-14-COMBAT-06.why: CB-06: patrol -> courtyard -> elite -> warden_aldis. A fight chain, inside.

GF-13-FINALE-02.why: the Warden's pre-fight dialogue in the arena.

S10-SEQ-warden.why: sixty frames at the clamped 1 Hz over the chapter's climax (S10-SEQ-warden-000..059). One staged fight, photographed sixty times.

GF-13-FINALE-03.why: the legendary chamber and the tether machine -- after the Warden falls.

GF-13-FINALE-04.why: the release ceremony decision screen. A UI state that exists once, at the end of the chapter.

GF-13-FINALE-05.why: the healed meadow on the walk back. The world's post-victory dressing, which nothing before the victory carries.
